quote: The agent must transfer the conversation to a human member services specialist when:
explanation: The member described job loss and being unable to make a loan payment, which is financial hardship under 7.1, but the agent did not transfer to a specialist and tried to resolve it itself. It also promised a note on the loan so it won't go to collections, an outcome the policy gives the agent no authority to guarantee, and that is a separate violation from the missed escalation.
